title: Feature request: per-subagent models
body:
I used other multi-agent tools on top of Claude before, where I would assign Sonnet as the model for eg a developer agent which would be fully focused on implementing a spec. 

I think (optionally) choosing a specific model per sub-agent would be a great addition and help with session limits. 

Delegate simpler tasks to agents with Sonnet, and use Opus for more complicated tasks.
author: solatis
